data.body:
[P2] Reject conflicting values for an existing effect identity

`setdefault` preserves an earlier positive allowance when the same operation ID later appears with an unexpected value. For example, an `item` binding with `count=2, values=(1,)` accepts two bodies sharing one ID with values `1` and `2`: the allowance remains two, nothing is reported missing, and the aggregate side-effect count passes. This accepts an unexpected effect while omitting one required occurrence. Track each ID's expected key and reject conflicting or unexpected keys even after an allowance was assigned; add a regression covering this sequence.
